description: Manage Kubernetes from the sidebar — workloads, pods, services and the rest of a namespace, with live logs, supervised port-forwards and an inline preview of what a service serves.
author: Risa Labs

definedPermissions.name: kubernetes.manage
definedPermissions.description: Change cluster state: apply manifests, delete, scale and restart Kubernetes resources, install, upgrade, roll back or uninstall Helm releases, and register or remove chart repositories

definedPermissions.name: kubernetes.exec
definedPermissions.description: Open an interactive shell inside a pod — arbitrary command execution in the cluster with that pod's credentials, including access to its mounted Secrets

definedPermissions.name: helm.publish
definedPermissions.description: Push packaged Helm charts to an OCI registry
